fight_technique_name: False Base Station Or Access Point
actions: Isolate the rogue cell by blocking its TAC in MME/SMF via dynamic TAC blacklist.
Enforce strict NAS security mode commands (NAS-SMC) for all UE attachments.
Deploy 5G NAS integrity protection with 128-bit keys for all NAS messages.
Enable NAS replay protection with a 10-message sliding window.
Configure MME to reject NAS messages from unknown TACs within 5-minute windows.
Implement NAS cause code monitoring with alerts for cause 39 spikes.
Update RAN to enforce 5G NAS security mode 3 (full integrity protection).
Set MME to drop NAS messages without valid NAS security header.
Deploy NAS trace analysis to detect abnormal NAS reset patterns.
Enable NAS security mode enforcement for all UE contexts in 5G.

mapped_mitigations.fgm_name: Discard RAN Signaling Received Without Integrity Protection
Cross Check Between Application Layer And Transport Layer
